title: 第五章龙家杀心狡兔死走狗烹第六章先下手为强
content_zh:
“小子，拜托了！！”
就在秦风一时之间不知道该如何回应时，龙天再次无比期待道。
似乎非要听到秦风答应自己这个要求才行。
“好的，前辈！我答应了。”
“请前辈放心，无论以后龙家与我之间的关系如何，我都会保证不会断了龙家香火，但我却无法保证，其余家族势力或特殊情况的出现。”
秦风回答的十分巧妙道。
龙天闻言，也没再多说什么，而是露出了释怀的笑容。
像是完成了心愿般，瞬间轻松了不少。
“有你这句话，就足够了。”
“老夫该消失了。”
“不管怎么说，可算等到了点亮三盏龙灯的有缘人。”
“希望日后，你能让九龙至尊诀，扬名神界吧！！”
“呵呵呵呵！！”
话音落下，龙天便化为无数道光芒消散在了秦风眼帘。
看着龙家这位老祖消失后，秦风心里有种说不出来的感觉，好像这位龙家老祖对自己十分忌惮一样，否则又岂回说出那番话来？
还有，秦风有些怀疑这什么九龙至尊诀以及九龙至尊鼎，是不是真有那么厉害，毕竟人家刚才也说了，只是捡来的东西，既然是捡来的，又能有多厉害呢？
就在秦风心有所想时。
突然，神龙之声却再次响起道：“小子，在这里好好吸收一下神龙真元的力量吧，足够让你修为有所突破。”
“现在不吸收的话，说不定待会就没机会吸收了。”
“龙家族人未必会放过你。”

“你现在不过通天境，应该对付不了龙家吧？”
听闻此话，秦风顿时脸色一沉到：“神龙前辈，此话怎讲？难道龙家会因为我点亮了三盏龙灯，而对付我？”
“你说呢？刚才龙天老头的话，不是很明显么？”
“你既不是龙家血脉者，而且身世成谜，但凡龙家族长不傻，都不会让你活着离开龙家。”
“要是让外界势力知道，龙家传承被一个养子所得，龙家名誉何在？”
“小子，话不多说，你自己好好想想。”
“如今神龙真元在你体内，要么你尽快吸收，看能增强多少修为，要么你现在就离去，看能不能活着离开龙家再说。”
“总之，在三盏龙灯熄灭之前，你得想好才行。”
“龙灯一灭，龙家族人肯定会进入此地，来找你麻烦。”
“好自为之！！”
话音落下，神龙之声也彻底消失。
而眼前的景象也变回了之前的样子！！
看着正在燃烧的三盏龙灯，秦风陷入了沉默之中。
要是龙家会因此对付自己，该怎么办？自己不过通天境修为，虽然在龙家年轻一辈中强无敌，可面对龙家高层等人，还是有点不够看，特别是养父龙战，那可是货真价实的登天境强者！！比就要足足高一个大境界。
其余高层们，也几乎都是通天境后期或者圆满境，更不是自己一人所能对付的。
东土大陆，强者为尊。
每一位诞生出来的生命，都能够吸收天地灵气而进行修炼突破，而境界等级也十分明确，分别为《入灵境》、《灵气境》、《灵海境》、《通天境》、《踏天境》以及《炼天境》。
每个大境界，又分为初，中，后以及圆满四个小境界。
大境界的差距，犹如鸿沟无法跨越，但小境界的差距，却能通过功法以及一些特殊手段去弥补。
功法也分为小，大，天三种。

小功法寻常修士都可修炼，一般的家族势力，或者灵气境的修士，都有着小功法傍身。
而大功法则是灵海境以上的修士才能修炼或者拥有，即便是像龙家这种强大的家族，也对大功法无比看重。
至于天功法，那就不用过多言语了。
哪怕是龙家，也只有三种天功法的存在，而且只有修为达到了通天境的族人，才有资格染指天功法。
content_en:
"Boy, please!!"
Just when Qin Feng didn't know how to respond, Long Tian once again said with great expectation.
It seemed that he had to hear Qin Feng agree to his request.
"Okay, senior! I agree."
"Senior, please rest assured. No matter what the relationship between the Long family and I will be in the future, I will ensure that I will not cut off the Long family's incense, but I cannot guarantee that other family forces or special circumstances will appear."
Qin Feng answered very cleverly.
When Long Tian heard this, he didn't say anything more, but showed a relieved smile.
As if my wish had been fulfilled, I felt a lot more relaxed instantly.
"Your words are enough."
"It's time for me to disappear."
"Anyway, I'm waiting for the destined person to light up the three dragon lanterns."
"I hope that in the future, you can make the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique famous in the divine world!!"
"Hehehehe!!"
As soon as the words fell, Long Tian turned into countless rays of light and disappeared in Qin Feng's eyes.
After watching the ancestor of the Long family disappear, Qin Feng felt an indescribable feeling in his heart, as if the ancestor of the Long family was very afraid of him, otherwise why would he say those words?
Also, Qin Feng is a little doubtful whether these Nine Dragons Supreme Technique and Nine Dragons Supreme Cauldron are really that powerful. After all, they just said that they are just picked up things. Since they are picked up, how powerful can they be?
Just when Qin Feng had something in mind.
Suddenly, the voice of the divine dragon sounded again: "Boy, absorb the power of the divine dragon's true essence here, it will be enough for you to make a breakthrough in your cultivation."
"If you don't absorb it now, you might not have the chance to absorb it later."
"The Long family members may not let you go."
"You are not in the Tongtian realm now, so you shouldn't be able to deal with the Long family, right?"
After hearing this, Qin Feng's face suddenly darkened: "Senior Shenlong, how can you say this? Will the Long family deal with me because I lit three dragon lanterns?"
"What do you think? Isn't it obvious what old man Long Tian said just now?"
"You are not a member of the Long family, and your life experience is a mystery. As long as the head of the Long family is not stupid, he will not let you leave the Long family alive."
"If outside forces know that the Long family's inheritance was acquired by an adopted son, where will the Long family's reputation be?"
"Boy, don't say much, think about it yourself."
"Now that the divine dragon essence is in your body, you can either absorb it as soon as possible and see how much cultivation it can enhance, or you can leave now and see if you can leave the Long family alive."
"Anyway, you have to think carefully before the three dragon lanterns go out."
"As soon as the dragon lantern goes out, the Dragon family members will definitely enter this place and come to trouble you."
“It’s good to do it for yourself!!”
As soon as the words fell, the dragon's voice completely disappeared.
And the scene in front of me has changed back to what it was before! !
Looking at the three burning dragon lanterns, Qin Feng fell into silence.
What if the Long family will deal with themselves because of this? Although he is invincible among the younger generation of the Long family, he is still a bit unsatisfied when facing the senior officials of the Long family, especially his adoptive father, Long Zhan, who is a genuine strong man in the Heaven realm! ! It's a much higher realm than that.
The other high-level officials are almost all in the late Tongtian realm or the Perfection realm, and they are not something that I can handle alone.
In the Eastern Continent, the strong are respected.
Every life that is born can absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and make breakthroughs in cultivation, and the realm levels are also very clear, namely "Enter the Spirit Realm", "Aura Realm", "Spiritual Sea Realm", "Tongtian Realm", "Treading the Heaven Realm" and "Refining Heaven Realm".
Each major realm is divided into four smaller realms: initial, middle, final and perfect.
The gap in large realms is like a chasm that cannot be crossed, but the gap in small realms can be bridged through exercises and some special means.
Kung Fu is also divided into three types: small, big, and heaven.
Small skills can be practiced by ordinary monks, and ordinary family forces can practice them.Or monks in the spirit realm, all have small skills at their disposal.
The Great Techniques can only be practiced or possessed by monks above the Spiritual Sea Realm. Even a powerful family like the Long Family values ​​the Great Techniques extremely highly.
As for the Tian Gong method, there is no need to say too much about it.
Even in the Long family, there are only three kinds of heavenly arts, and only clan members who have reached the Heaven-reaching realm are qualified to get involved in the heavenly arts.
